repairs.rationale: Name the production case and deliberate descriptor intervention before describing their outcomes, so the reader has the actual configuration rather than an ordinary-launch generalization to retract.

The recorded launch observation found matching
plain and environment-displaying process output, inherited null-device standard
output/error, and the expected protocol endpoints.

edits.after:
The recorded production launch case used an empty allow-default specimen.
Its observation found matching plain and environment-displaying process output,
inherited null-device standard output/error, and the expected protocol endpoints.

before.quote:
With stdin closed
in the low-descriptor control, evidence is allocated at fd 0.

edits.after:
The low-descriptor fixture deliberately closes stdin and low unused
descriptors before exercising launch setup. In that configuration, evidence is
allocated at fd 0.

before.quote:
These controlled launches do not establish that an ordinary XPC
host starts with the same descriptor arrangement.

repairs.title: Name adapter calls instead of general native uses
repairs.rationale: The actual control-flow observation is through fixture adapters. Naming their concrete action removes the broader libc-behavior premise.

before.quote:
Failed handle initialization reaches later uses of the
invalid handle; fixture adapters contain those uses, so the controls establish
continued host flow without claiming libc's behavior on that input.

edits.after:
After a failed handle initialization, the fixture adapters record subsequent
invalid-handle uses and return EINVAL. Their receipts record the host control
flow through those adapter calls.

repairs.preserved: Unchecked production setup and the other actual failure-flow observations remain. Fixture containment remains explicit. This does not close the reopened setup-verification finding.
repairs.guard_absent_read: The described EINVAL comes from an adapter whose calls are named. Reading the paragraph supplies an adapter receipt, not an observed libc call on that invalid handle.
repairs.verification: Match the fixture contract at its invalid-handle boundary; retain the existing link to host setup controls and its fixture contract.

repairs.title: Name the source of attempt status
repairs.rationale: Replace high-level success phrasing with the operation whose return determines attempt status; preserve independent filesystem observations beside it.

before.quote: Opens read-only, attempts a one-byte read and close, and discards those latter returns. Published success is the open result, with an available descriptor-path observation.

edits.after: Opens read-only. The open result determines the published attempt status. On successful open, records an available descriptor-path observation, attempts a one-byte read and close, and discards those latter returns.

before.quote: Opens with `O_WRONLY \| O_TRUNC`, then attempts to write `x` and close. Published success is the open result; the write and close returns are discarded.

edits.after: Opens with `O_WRONLY \| O_TRUNC`. The open result determines the published attempt status. On successful open, attempts to write `x` and close and discards their returns.

before.quote:
The source
establishes where each call occurs and which returns are discarded; those are
separate from an independently observed filesystem effect.

edits.before: Source-only; creation not implied for existing target
edits.after: Source-only; conditional new-object acquisition at open(O_CREAT)

repairs.preserved: Native operations, status transformation, discarded returns, existing-target/no-truncation behavior, source-only evidence and the existing-file byte/identity control remain. Attempt status is not relabeled as a raw syscall return.
repairs.guard_absent_read: An open can determine attempt status while a later write fails; the draft explicitly discards the write return. Existing-target behavior is still stated in the create row, and S31b is expressly conditional.
repairs.verification: Review against the original action table and the attempt-channel contract. Retain every operation and returned/discarded-status distinction; no new filesystem-effect observation is claimed.
